inputs.prompt: Animate this exact hand-drawn 2D Japanese anime frame. Preserve ink outlines, hard-edged cel shading, flat matte skin, broad hair locks and painted gothic backgrounds throughout. Preserve identities, clothing, number of characters and established scenery. Intentional animation with anticipation, force, follow-through and settle; no loop, CGI, extra limbs, character morphing, unrelated cut, orbit or unmotivated zoom. The one physical fan leaf flies screen right and meets the single amber projectile. At contact its thin blue-violet film brightens, fractures into a few drawn fragments and disappears; the amber projectile breaks apart. The solid leaf remains whole, slows and starts falling only AFTER contact. Brief lateral camera follow then stop on collision. One impact, no prolonged free flight.
